title: DRACO: a Cross-Domain Benchmark for Deep Research Accuracy, Completeness, and Objectivity
authors_zh: Joey Zhong, Hao Zhang, Clare Southern, Jeremy Yang, Thomas Wang 等
paper_type_zh: 真实深度研究请求的跨域 rubric 评测基准
best_for_zh: 研究深度研究 Agent、真实用户任务和报告质量 Judge 的读者。
one_line: DRACO scores real deep-research reports for accuracy, completeness, objectivity, and citation quality.
DRACO 用来自真实深度研究使用模式的任务及四维 rubric，审查报告的准确、完整、客观和引用质量。
why: It grounds report evaluation in diverse real-world research requests rather than synthetic prompts.
inclusion_reason: DRACO brings task-specific expert-like rubrics to real deep-research use patterns.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Deep-research benchmarks are often researcher-authored and may not reflect real user demand, while single-reference evaluation poorly captures completeness, objectivity, and citation quality across international sources. A fluent report may still fail on facts, viewpoint balance, or evidence coverage.

DRACO samples and augments anonymised real deep-research requests and uses task-specific rubrics to evaluate accuracy, completeness, objective presentation, and citations.

深度研究基准常由研究者自拟问题，可能与真实用户需求分布脱节；部分任务又依赖单一参考答案，难以评价跨国家信息源中的完整性、客观性和引用质量。系统可能写出流畅报告，却在事实、观点平衡或证据覆盖上失败。

DRACO 从真实匿名深研请求中抽样并增强任务，以任务专属 rubric 同时评价准确、完整、客观呈现和引用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DRACO spans ten domains and draws on information sources from forty countries. Tasks originate from de-identified Perplexity Deep Research requests and are filtered and augmented to be open-ended, complex, objectively evaluable, and private-information-free. Task-specific rubrics cover factual accuracy, analytical breadth and depth, presentation quality and objectivity, and citation quality. The public data support realistic deep-research agent and judge evaluation.
DRACO 覆盖十个领域，并使用来自 40 个国家的信息源。任务源自去标识的 Perplexity Deep Research 请求，经筛选与增强后确保开放、复杂、可客观评价和无个人信息。每题 rubric 分为事实准确性、分析广度与深度、呈现质量与客观性、引用质量四类。公开数据适合真实分布深研 Agent 和 Judge 评测。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Sample real requests: De-identified queries are sampled from large-scale deep-research usage to preserve realistic demand.
  1. Filter and augment: Private, simple, and non-objectively evaluable queries are removed, and complexity and cross-source requirements are added.
  1. Curate rubrics: Experts author task-specific criteria for accuracy, completeness, objective presentation, and citations.
  1. Standardised scoring: Agent reports are judged criterion by criterion and aggregated across four dimensions; web time, judge, and search budget must be fixed.

1. 抽样真实请求： 从大规模深研系统使用数据中抽取去标识查询，保留真实需求分布。
  1. 筛选与增强： 删除隐私、简单检索和不可客观评判任务，并补充复杂度与跨源要求。
  1. 策划 rubric： 专家按准确、完整、客观呈现和引用四维编写任务专属准则。
  1. 统一评分： Agent 生成长报告后逐条判定并汇总四维分数；复现需固定网页时间、Judge 和搜索预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Comparisons of several deep-research systems on realistic tasks show different trade-offs among factual accuracy, completeness, objectivity, and citation quality, with no single system dominating every dimension. This supports four-dimensional diagnosis over one holistic score. However, tasks originate from one commercial platform, so user and regional distributions affect representativeness.
论文在真实分布任务上比较多种深研系统，结果显示各系统在事实准确、完整性、客观性和引用质量之间存在不同权衡，没有单一系统在所有维度占优。该结果支持四维拆分相对于整体分的诊断价值；但任务源自一个商业平台，用户群体和地区分布可能影响基准代表性。

title: Novelty
新意
html: DeepResearch Bench uses expert-authored PhD tasks, whereas DRACO begins with real user requests and makes them evaluable through filtering and augmentation, emphasising sources from forty countries and objectivity. The novelty is combining in-the-wild demand with four-dimensional expert rubrics, not a new research agent.
DeepResearch Bench 等工作由专家主动构造博士级任务，DRACO 则从真实用户请求出发，再通过筛选与增强建立可评测任务，并强调跨 40 国来源与客观性。新意是将 in-the-wild 需求分布和四维 expert rubric 结合，而非提出新的研究 Agent。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: Tasks come from one platform and may reflect its paying users and product interaction.
  1. Limitation 2: Access to dynamic international sources varies by region and time.
  1. Limitation 3: Objectivity contains value judgments and may differ across experts.

1. 局限1： 任务来自单一平台，可能偏向其付费用户与产品交互方式。
  1. 局限2： 动态网页和国际来源的可访问性会随地区变化。
  1. 局限3： 客观性评价本身含价值判断，不同专家可能给出不同标准。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Compare deep-research agents on accuracy, completeness, objectivity, and citations separately.
  1. Use case 2: Use real requests and rubrics to calibrate production-facing judges.
  1. Use case 3: Before cross-platform use, inspect user-distribution and regional-source bias.

1. 使用场景1： 比较深研 Agent 的准确、完整、客观和引用质量，不只报告总分。
  1. 使用场景2： 用真实请求和 rubric 校准 production-facing Judge。
  1. 使用场景3： 跨平台应用前应检查用户分布和地区信息源偏差。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Build a cross-domain, international deep-research benchmark from real requests.
  2. Method: De-identified sampling, complexity filtering, four-dimensional rubrics, and scoring.
  3. Data: Ten domains, sources from forty countries, and task-specific criteria.
  4. Evidence: Systems trade off accuracy, completeness, objectivity, and citations.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for in-the-wild research judges; audit platform bias.

1. 一句话定位： 从真实请求构建跨域、跨国深研 rubric 基准。
  2. 方法抓手： 去标识抽样、复杂度筛选、四维准则和统一评分。
  3. 数据抓手： 10 领域、40 国信息源及任务专属 rubric。
  4. 证据锚点： 不同系统在准确、完整、客观和引用间存在权衡。
  5. 复用决定： 适合真实分布深研 Judge；须审计平台偏差。
